description: Unofficial fan-art animated companion inspired by Daxter from Jak and Daxter. Features expressive long-ear chatter, goggles adjustment, tail-assisted tiny-wrench inspection, a harmless balance mishap, a long-tailed leap and three articulated bipedal running views. Tail-to-hand tool passing and the miniature wrench are original exaggerated choreography. Independently drawn; not endorsed by the rights holder.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
